name: Cash Balance Return Criteria 2
definition: Defines the criteria used to report on the cash balance.

TypeIndicator.name: Type Indicator
TypeIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the balance type is requested.

StatusIndicator.name: Status Indicator
StatusIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the balance status is requested.

ValueDateIndicator.name: Value Date Indicator
ValueDateIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the value date is requested.

ProcessingDateIndicator.name: Processing Date Indicator
ProcessingDateIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the processing date is requested.

NumberOfPaymentsIndicator.name: Number Of Payments Indicator
NumberOfPaymentsIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the number of payment is requested.
